items.title: A helicopter finally reaches flood-isolated Tiru of Rasuwa, 15 days after the devastating deluge
items.blurb: With all roads and bridges washed away by the catastrophic August 26 floods, the village has been effectively cut off from the outside world.

items.title: Rapid assessment puts Bhotekoshi recovery needs at Rs723 billion
items.blurb: Three-quarters of the bill is tied to infrastructure, with hydropower, roads, homes, and essential services among the hardest hit.

items.title: Climate loss and damage fund moves to consider urgent support for Nepal
items.blurb: FRLD co-chairs say they are working with the Board to respond to Kathmandu’s request following the August 26 Bhotekoshi floods.

items.title: Germany provides €8 million in assistance to Nepal after Bhotekoshi floods
items.blurb: The package includes emergency relief, humanitarian aid and development support for health, energy and disaster-resilient infrastructure.

items.title: Nepal’s climate problem is becoming an economic one
items.blurb: Experts say the country needs to shift from rebuilding after disasters to planning development around climate risk.

items.title: Nepal announces ‘scholarship bank’ for children orphaned or displaced by floods
items.blurb: The government says it will guarantee education through Grade 12 for affected children, with support ranging from residential care and full scholarships to educational materials.

items.title: Nepal must restore tourist confidence as floods threaten arrivals
items.blurb: The August 26 floods have disrupted some tourism sites, but most of Nepal’s major destinations remain open.

items.title: Disaster reaches children through their screens. This must stop
items.blurb: Sometimes protecting a child can be as simple as deciding not to press ‘post’ or ‘share’.

items.title: Nepal secures $20 million from Loss and Damage Fund, awaits decision on Bhotekoshi plea
items.blurb: The funding was approved based on Nepal’s request made earlier this year. A separate emergency appeal filed after the August 26 disaster awaits approval.

items.title: Two weeks on, families wait for DNA answers
items.blurb: Relatives of people missing after the Bhotekoshi floods are turning to DNA testing to identify recovered bodies, but labs are overloaded and under-resourced.

items.title: An algorithm is trying to put names to Nepal’s flood dead
items.blurb: Facial-recognition technology FaceTagr is helping families search for possible matches, but police say DNA testing remains the only reliable option for badly damaged remains.

items.title: Rabi Lamichhane urges action against those targeting flood victims online
items.blurb: The RSP chair says the Bhotekoshi floods should be declared a national climate-related disaster and calls for a special all-party parliamentary committee to oversee the response and long-term recovery.

items.title: ‘You are not alone, Nepal’: UEFA Champions League pays tribute to flood victims
items.blurb: European football’s elite competition will observe a moment of silence and display solidarity banners across all 18 opening-week matches following the late-August disaster in central Nepal.

items.title: Nepal restores power, rebuilds links in flood-hit Rasuwa and Nuwakot
items.blurb: Electricity has returned to more communities as the Nepali Army works to install a temporary bridge after floods destroyed key infrastructure.

items.title: Nepal waives health insurance fees in flood-hit districts
items.blurb: Patients in Rasuwa, Nuwakot and Dhading will not have to pay co-payments or show physical insurance cards for three months.

items.title: Water flow returns to normal in Kaski river after temporary blockage
items.blurb: The Kimrong Khola was temporarily blocked on Tuesday, prompting precautionary evacuations downstream, but the blockage began clearing overnight and the river has since returned to its normal flow.

items.title: Global backing grows for Nepal’s climate aid appeal
items.blurb: More than a dozen members of the UN-backed Loss and Damage Fund are pushing for an emergency board meeting to consider Nepal’s request for support after the Bhotekoshi floods.
